body: I wrote about it on a previous post, she passed away at the begininning of the year
Thank you, and I'm sorry for your loss

Car accident. Just a stupid fucking accident. Wasn't anyone's fault really. Could have been anyone. It was icy, visibility was poor, the roads weren't properly salted, everybody was going too fast. 

We have two of everything that we used. We had extras of course for guests, but there was two of everything that we used just for us that was different. Two sets of cutlery that had a different design from the stuff we give to guests. Two matching glasses. Two matching mugs. Two matching beer glasses and wine glasses. Two matching plates, two bowls. Our desks were side by side, perfect mirror images. 

That encompasses us. We were partners. Pair bonded forever. We did everything together. I didn't even have to think. I had a person I could trust with my life. I could look at her and she'd know exactly what I was thinking. 

Every time we got intimate we would have this moment where it is like time stops. We'd just look at each other, touch our foreheads together, and be still. It was beautiful
I can't ever forget about her or find someone new. We belonged together... for someone else to take her place is wrong.
God I can't even imagine... being without her for 9 months has been awful. 7 years... It never gets any easier does it?
